parameters.name: Conditions
parameters.description:
The rule conditions. The value is in the JSON format. Valid values of keys:

*   **condition**: the matching condition.
*   **type**: the matching type.
*   **value**: the matching value.

parameters.name: EventKey
parameters.description: The keyword of the alert item.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: The name of the alert item.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The alert type.

*   Set the value to **sensitiveFile**.

parameters.name: Note
parameters.description: The remarks that you want to add.

parameters.name: OperationCode
parameters.description:
The operation code.

*   Set the value to **whitelist** to add the alert item to the whitelist.

parameters.name: Scenarios
parameters.description:
The application scope of the rule. The value is in the JSON format. Valid values of keys:

*   **type**
*   **value**

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the whitelist. Valid values:

*   **image**: image.
*   **agentless**: agentless detection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas add-image-event-operation --event-type sensitiveFile --operation-code whitelist --conditions condition_:_MD5_,_type_:_equals_,_value_:_0083a31cc0083a31ccf7c10367a6e783e --scenarios type_:_repo_,_value_:_test-aaa/shenzhen-repo-01 --event-key PEM --event-name PEM --source agentless --note test --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
